about.body: I'm Francis, but most friends call me Cisco. I'm from Tanzania and currently study at Don State Technical University in Russia. I build websites, work on products and help people sort out computer problems.
about.approachBody: I ask questions before I start building. Who will use this? What do they need to do? Then I work through the design and code, and check it on a phone as well as a laptop.
about.globalBody: Growing up in Tanzania and continuing my education in Russia has given me a personal connection to building across cultures. I bring that curiosity to each project, and keep learning through practical work.
about.languageBody: I speak English and Kiswahili fluently, and a little French.

pricing.hostingIntro: Your website build and running costs are separate. We agree the hosting setup and monthly resource budget before launch.
pricing.allocation: Reference capacity is shared hosting capacity, not a guaranteed allowance for each website. Your project’s allocation is agreed before launch; databases and file storage are scoped separately.
pricing.upgradeTitle: When your site needs more resources
pricing.upgradeBody: If your site exceeds its agreed resource allocation, budget from this amount each month for a server-resource upgrade.
pricing.overages: Extra server resources start at approximately {monthly} per month. This is not unlimited usage; higher usage, taxes and paid services are quoted separately.
pricing.aftercareBody: Changes and updates after completion are priced by the workload, from a small content edit to a more involved change. I’ll quote the work before making it.
pricing.domainAnswer: One standard domain is included in the build. We’ll agree the extension, registration period and renewal cost in your quote. Premium names and future renewals may cost extra.
pricing.providersQuestion: Are email, WhatsApp and storage subscriptions included?
pricing.providersAnswer: The packages cover the integration and setup described above. Included WhatsApp notifications are limited to 3 specified destination chats, whether individual numbers or groups. Notifications to different users’ chats require the monthly WhatsApp add-on. Other ongoing email, WhatsApp API, database and storage charges are quoted separately.
